cards.title: Cross Aransas Pass Causeway
cards.mapFocus: (KNGP) Corpus Christi NAS/Shamrock Arrivals/Aransas Pass Causeway
instructions: Cross the causeway at 1,000' MSL · 240 KIAS
Descend to 1,000' MSL prior to the causeway
Be alert for other Northern Arrival traffic and for traffic on the Goliad Arrival at the causeway
Proceed direct to Point Shamrock, maintain 1,000' MSL
cards.source: Binder, p. 63; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slides 102–103.

cards.title: Terminate with Corpus Approach at Shamrock
cards.mapFocus: (KNGP) Corpus Christi NAS/Shamrock Arrivals/PT Shamrock/PT Shamrock
